name: Amazon Future Engineer Scholarship (India)
provider: Amazon India, implemented with Foundation for Excellence

rules.quote: The AFE scholarship provides ₹2 lakh in financial assistance over four years to female students pursuing B.E. or B.Tech degrees in computer science or allied branches, from low-income backgrounds.

value: B.E./B.Tech Computer Science and allied branches
rules.quote: female students pursuing B.E. or B.Tech degrees in computer science or allied branches

rules.value: low-income families (no numeric limit in source)
rules.quote: providing female engineering students from low-income families with financial support, mentorship, and career opportunities in technology

rules.value: selection on merit, financial need and leadership
rules.quote: Scholars are selected through a rigorous process evaluating academic merit, financial need, and leadership potential.

amount.text: Rs 2 lakh over four years, plus laptop, bootcamps, mentorship and paid internship after second year
amount.quote: The AFE scholarship provides ₹2 lakh in financial assistance over four years
